major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open into it a couple of globals into the pull, then spam Crash Lightning whenever it is ready and Windstrike every other GCD, letting Thorim's Invocation spend your Maelstrom Weapon while it is active.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown is 180s; the guide states Thorim's Invocation reduces this to 120s, which is the standard build. Choice node against Doom Winds, so mark talent_gated.

major_cooldowns.name: Doom Winds
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Trigger it off the GCD and fill every GCD inside it with Crash Lightning or Stormstrike, letting Thorim's Invocation spend your Maelstrom Weapon instead of casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning yourself.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 469270 is the cast id with parse evidence; 466772 is its self-buff aura; 384352 shares the name, matches the guide's stated 60s cooldown, but was not observed as a cast in the sampled parses. Choice node against Ascendance.

major_cooldowns.name: Surging Totem
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it every minute for the Totemic build, then immediately run Sundering into a Lava Lash to consume Whirling Fire and start Hot Hand, syncing the whole sequence with Doom Winds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Exclusive to the Totemic hero talent, not observed in the sampled parses (likely all Stormbringer logs), but the guide describes it in detail as the Totemic burst cooldown button.

major_cooldowns.name: Sundering
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it every 30 seconds as your burst AoE line attack, pairing it with Doom Winds and Surging Totem for Totemic or leaning on its Surging Elements haste to empower Ascendance for Stormbringer AoE.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses, but the guide names it explicitly as a 30s-cooldown button the Totemic build always takes and Stormbringer takes for AoE.

defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press it when you are about to take a big hit or a heavy damage stretch, since it cuts down what lands on you for its duration.

rules.description: Voltaic Blaze into Stormstrike then Ascendance
rules.action: Open with Voltaic Blaze, land one Stormstrike for starting Maelstrom Weapon, then press Ascendance.

rules.description: Thorim's Invocation spends for you during Doom Winds
rules.action: Do not manually spend Lightning Bolt while Doom Winds is up, let Thorim's Invocation discharge it through Stormstrike or Crash Lightning instead.

rules.description: Spend Lightning Bolt at high Maelstrom Weapon stacks
rules.action: Hold Lightning Bolt for a high stack of Maelstrom Weapon, only dropping down early when Elemental Tempo would reset Lava Lash or extend Hot Hand.

rules.description: Cast Tempest the moment it procs
rules.action: Cast Tempest as soon as it procs instead of banking Maelstrom Weapon into Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning.

rules.description: Chain Lightning replaces Lightning Bolt in AoE
rules.action: Switch your Maelstrom Weapon spender from Lightning Bolt to Chain Lightning once more than one target is up.
